name: codex-architecture-governance
description: Evidence-bound software system assessment, technical solution decisions, remediation planning, portfolio governance, and deterministic quality gates for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Assess software systems across architecture and engineering qualities such as performance, reliability, security boundaries, data, operations, and maintainability. Verify evidence and provenance, compare architecture and technology options, record decisions, plan migrations, govern portfolios, and enforce trusted findings with layered deterministic policy. Local helpers require Python 3.11–3.13 with PyYAML and jsonschema.
defaultPrompt: Assess this repository across architecture and engineering quality, then verify every finding.
Compare technical solution options and record an evidence-backed decision.
Run the layered quality gate on the latest trusted review.
